label: copy-phase re-input of s / 1 (also c, j, f, l), sparse context-dependent subset
predicate: (phase == 2) & isin(in_tok, [tok("s"), tok("1"), tok("c"), tok("j"), tok("f"), tok("l")])
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (93% of mass), when the token fed back in is s (46% of mass) or 1 (26%), and less often c, j, f or l. About half the mass sits at recall_idx 1, the step right after <DEL> where the input is orig(0), so sequences that start with s are strongly enriched. Rate also rises at late copy steps (t 16-17). When the previous input is <DEL>, o or a, the rate goes up. It rarely fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on first occurrences of a token. The feature is extremely sparse: even s at recall_idx 1 triggers it only about 3% of the time. Adding conditions on the previous token, the next output, or q/v/w appearing in the sequence raises precision only to 1-8%, so whatever selects the small active subset was not captured. Activations are in a narrow band (median 0.12, max 0.23), and the strongest ones are s at recall_idx 1. Dev: recall 0.89, mass recall 0.90, precision 0.003.
